verdicts.reason: In A, the dark header bar doesn't reach the canvas edges: there is a gap on the left and a wider one on the right, so it looks broken. A also leaves a large dead gap between the eyebrow and the headline, and 'Ships late June' drifts about 90px below the CTA it belongs to. B keeps the full-width header and a clean centred stack, but it moves the orange divider from under the headline to between the body copy and the button. B's 'Ships late June' still sits loosely below the CTA, and its eyebrow and legal text are very small.
